fact: On 19 October 2026 the higher education minister agreed with enterprises a joint framework with the National Commission responsible for implementing the National AI Strategy to prepare a roadmap to 2030 with funding mechanisms; funding is to be mobilised, none is stated as allocated.
title: Minister of Higher Education and Scientific Research Chairs a Working Session on Mobilising National Funding and Developing High-Performance Computing and Artificial Intelligence Infrastructure
publisher: Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research
